summary: Comprehensive testing of Queue Management Application completed. Backend APIs working well (17/18 tests passed). Frontend pages loading correctly with proper navigation. Core functionality including registration, login, queue creation, QR code generation, client ticket taking, and ticket viewing all working. Main issue identified: session persistence problem causing users to be logged out intermittently.

minor_issues.issue: WebSocket library not available for testing in environment
minor_issues.impact: Cannot verify WebSocket real-time functionality programmatically

session_management.issue: JWT tokens appear to expire quickly causing frequent logouts
session_management.impact: Users get logged out during normal usage

session_issues.issue: Users get redirected to login page unexpectedly during navigation

design_compliance.issue: Design follows guidelines well - indigo/orange colors, Manrope font for headings, proper spacing

passed_tests: Client queue page access via QR URL
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session persistence issue - JWT tokens seem to expire too quickly causing users to be logged out during normal usage. Consider implementing token refresh mechanism or increasing token expiration time. Also install websocket-client library for WebSocket testing.

success_percentage.integration: 85% (works but session issues affect user experience)
